items.description: Wire validate_and_dispatch into production dispatch pipeline (zero callsites)
Per-instrument-kind edge case table in discovery doc
Config loader wired into PolicyGuard/EvidenceGuard runtime
CI check: count of test params == count of Appendix A params
Reconcile loop integration test (unit tests prove signals, not loop)
§4.2 decision divergence: Other errors → Retryable regardless of expiry (accepted as safe)
NetEdgeInputMissing used as catch-all reject code for 3 different gates (net edge, pricer, cascading). pipeline.rs:208,221,227 + gate_outcome.rs:200. Monitoring cannot distinguish failure modes.

items.description: 7 production unwrap() calls in pending_exposure.rs. Guarded by prior checks but violates CLAUDE.md non-negotiable no-unwrap policy.
items.resolution: Replaced all 7 unwrap() calls with descriptive expect() messages including function name.

items.description: GateResults::all_passed() const fn (build_order_intent.rs:527) + deprecated build_order_intent() = full 9-gate bypass. Extends DEBT-S1-007-01 scope.
items.resolution: Gated all_passed() behind cfg(any(test, feature = "test-helpers")). Restricted new(pass) to pub(crate).

items.description: Pipeline uses deprecated WAL bypass path (pipeline.rs:261-264). Secure alternative build_order_intent_with_wal_gate() exists but is not used.
items.resolution: Migrated pipeline.rs and open_runtime.rs to use build_order_intent_with_wal_gate() via PrecomputedWalGate shim. Shim wraps precomputed bool — real WAL gate injection tracked as DEBT-FE-004-WAL.

items.description: ValidatedDispatch pub fields (dispatch_map.rs:78-84) make proof token forgeable. DEBT-S1-007-01 fix must also make token unforgeable.
items.resolution: Made ValidatedDispatch fields private, added getter methods. Private fields prevent external construction (no #[non_exhaustive] needed).

items.description: Replace PrecomputedWalGate migration shim with real WAL gate injection. PrecomputedWalGate wraps a precomputed bool — the exact pattern the WAL gate API was designed to eliminate.

escalations.resolution_required: Replace dispatch_consistency_passed: bool with ValidatedDispatch proof token (type exists at dispatch_map.rs:74)
